blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — A village councilor, tagged as a high-value target, was arrested in an anti-drug operation on Sunday, Nov. 15, in Guiuan, Eastern Samar. The arrested village official was only identified as “Basil,” 60 years old.
